configurations.name: coralogixApiKey
configurations.description: Coralogix personal or team API key with SLO:READCONFIG, ALERTS:READCONFIG, CASES:READ and METRICS.DATA-API#HIGH:READDATA. See API keys.

configurations.name: coralogixApiUrl
configurations.description: Your Coralogix API URL (e.g. https://api.eu2.coralogix.com) or the team URL you open in the browser (e.g. https://myteam.app.eu2.coralogix.com). The region is derived from it.
